paper_title: Dark Matter Axion Search Using a Josephson Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifier
notes: ADMX sidecar cavity search using a JTWPA. Excludes axion-photon couplings above ~1e-13 GeV^-1 over 4796.7-4799.5 MHz (axion masses ~19.835-19.847 ueV centered at 19.84 ueV).
